{{Quote|Tremel was becoming lax before you ever arrived. His unwillingness to adapt to the evolving Sith paradigm has become a liability. These are the actions of a traitor.|[[Darth Baras]], to his [[Empire's Wrath|new apprentice]]|<ref name="TOR:ANM" />}}
'''Tremel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was tasked in selecting worthy acolytes to become Sith. He was responsible for the arrival and initiation of a [[Empire's Wrath|promising acolyte]], who would become his protégé.

==Biography==
Tremel was a descendant of [[Hyron Tremel]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> For [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] between the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Tremel administered the trials to acolytes that proved themselves worthy to join the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. He made these trials very difficult so those who were strong would survive and the weak would not.<ref name="TOR:AY" />

Tremel was directly involved in selecting and preparing a promising [[Empire's Wrath|new acolyte]] to be a rival to [[Vemrin]], an acolyte seeking to become the new apprentice powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]]. Tremel considered Vemrin to be an "impure" Sith, as Vemrin had come from Balmorra rather than the old Sith Worlds, and Vemrin's family had no history of Sith lineage or even Force-sensitivity. To ensure Vemrin's rival would succeed, Tremel summoned the acolyte to Korriban ahead of schedule.<ref name="TOR:AY" />

{{GameDS}}
Tremel's unwillingness to adapt would prove to be his undoing, as Baras commanded his new apprentice to assassinate him. In the following duel, Tremel was outmatched and struck down by his former protégé, the latter bringing the former's hand back to Baras as proof of his [[Death/Legends|death]]. Tremel's daughter, [[Eskella Gryton]], was also slain later by Baras's apprentice after she tried to exact revenge for her father's demise. His protégé would eventually win Baras's favor, dueling and killing Vemrin when confronted inside the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]].<ref name="TOR:ANM" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|In a drive for sheer numbers, the criteria for Academy admittance has been relaxed. Now ''anyone'' with Force sensitivity is allowed entrance. Vemrin is mixed blood. The invisible ''rot'' eating at the foundations of the Empire. He must ''not'' be allowed to advance.|Tremel, to his protégé|<ref name="TOR:AY" />}}
Tremel was a calm and collected man, a loyal subject to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]. He was displeased with the academy's policy for admittance, and in a broader scope, with the directions taken by the Empire during its conflict with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. His reluctance to embrace these changes was shown to be a major reason behind Baras's decision to have him assassinated.<ref name="TOR:AY" />

==Powers and abilities==
Tremel was proficient with his single-bladed [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] which he used in combat. Tremel had some power with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] as well.<ref name="TOR:ANM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tremel is voiced by [[Paul Darrow]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:ANM" /> Darrow passed away on June 3, 2019.<ref name="BBC">{{WebCite|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-48501099|text=Blake's 7 actor Paul Darrow dies at 78|archivedate=20190608135907}}</ref>

===Fate===
The Warrior can choose to either kill or spare Tremel. If killed, Eskella would attempt to avenge her father, only to be slain. If the Warrior spared his life then eventually an enraged Eskella found Tremel in hiding, she attacked him and Tremel was forced to kill his own daughter. Only then did he wish revenge on Baras for what he had done to him.<ref name="TOR:ANM" />

He would later come out of hiding at the request of [[Darth Vowrawn]] to bear witness to his student defeating Darth Baras and ending his claim as the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]].<ref name="TOR:ANM" />
